svg.title: Summary: gateway usage, Oct 7 to Nov 12, 2026
svg.desc: Summary chart of T3 Fleet Gateway usage from October 7 to November 12, 2026. All events: 8,461, of which Grok Bot jobs 5,754 (68%), Minions/Botons 1,614 (19%), adopted/standing 946 (11%) and other/test 147 (2%). A bracket marks the outer loop, Grok Bot plus Minions/Botons: 7,368 events, 87%. Jobs started or tracked: 376, of which Grok Bot 293 (78%), Minions/Botons 61 (16%), adopted/standing 10 and other/test 12.
svg.text: 87% from Grok Bot and Minions/Botons jobs
